ns2:course.label: Stats & Algo in Genomic Bio
ns2:course.description: This course will provide students with the practical knowledge of statistical analysis and computational modeling techniques relevant for applications in genomics and systems biology. The focus will be on the fundamental concepts and algorithms for gene finding, genome annotation, sequence alignment, phylogenetic reconstruction, gene expression and network analysis, Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS), etc. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: STAT 100, MCB 250, MATH 220, CS 101, or equivalent. Restricted to MEng Students only.
